Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Bars
Punchline: Show or hide hotbars depending on your class or job.
Description:
Show or hide hotbars depending on your class or job. Pick a hotbar, choose "Show only on" or "Hide on", and click the jobs it applies to. More hotbar magic is in the works!

Open the settings with /willobars.
Changelog:
- Remove the subtitle under the title
- Changing the theme no longer re-applies your hotbar rules
- Keep the first hotbar backup and stop backups from the same second overwriting each other
- Only change a hotbar's Shared setting when you change it yourself
